dependency_policy.jalali_date_picker: 1.0.0 runtime JS CDN + local CSS in verified baseline
dependency_policy.hls_js: major @1 runtime CDN in verified baseline

development_rules: Always start from version 1.2.6 until this lock is deliberately updated.
Never infer version from stale README or RELEASE-MANIFEST headings.
Never commit real config.php, DB credentials, ParsGreen secrets, stream keys or live passwords.
Do not call an artifact canonical unless byte size and SHA-256 match this lock.
Keep StreamEngineInterface boundary; do not couple the panel directly to FFmpeg/MediaMTX workers.
Preserve scheduler transaction, row-lock and overlap protections.
Preserve upload, SSRF, CSRF, session and rate-limit security hardening.
